limitations: The three reviews used separate contexts but the same model weights.
Only each reviewer's final Markdown response is preserved, not its full command-event stream.
The reviews were static committed-byte inspections and did not rerun the producer, verifier, tests, record validator, indexer, runner, or experiment.
The preservation transport occurred after each clean read-only review and is not part of the reviewed Git tree.
The historical focused manifest test synthesizes Git mode and type; all three reviewers therefore recomputed the authoritative receipt directly from git ls-tree.
The generic validator's 20-record receipt does not cover every custom or historical JSON file in the experiment tree.
Review verdicts authorize neither execution nor any mathematical or cryptanalytic claim without a coordinator decision and later plan review.
